title: Technology Sector Update for 12/07/2018: AMOT, CMTL, IBM, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT -2.26%
AAPL -2.04%
IBM -2.55%
CSCO -2.09%
GOOG -2.19%
Most technology stocks were lower Friday, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 down 2.8% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index losing 2.4% in value.
Moving stocks include:
(+) Allied Motion Technologies ( AMOT ) was up 14% after it announced its acquisition of acquired electronic manufacturing company TCI LLC for $64.1 million.
In other sector news:
(+) Comtech Telecommunications ( CMTL ) was 18% higher after it posted diluted EPS of $0.14 in Q1, beating analysts' estimates of a GAAP net loss of $0.06 per share in a Capital IQ poll, and reversing a net loss of $0.07 per share.
(-) International Business Machines ( IBM ) and India's HCL Technologies reached a deal for IBM to sell select software products to HCL for $1.8 billion. IBM was down 3% in recent trade.
